svg.text: Real-time indoor guidance for blind travellers
once per building, ahead of time
FastAPI, one process: on the Pi or a laptop behind a Cloudflare tunnel, or a cloud host
everyone talks to the same API over HTTPS
scan lined up with the footprint
the venue's own names for rooms
writes the building dossier; model: Gemini via LangChain
Lead plans the survey, delegates, then audits its own routes
the approach, from aerial and CoStar
joins buildings made of several scans
Hazard pass: every point-cloud lead gets a verdict
Code walks every lead, so the model can't skip one; the hazard-scout
judges each from a view rendered at it, stricter if CoStar says pre-ADA.
At JRR: 55 leads judged, 32 confirmed (26 glass, 6 overhead), 23 rejected.
Tools: look at a panorama, find overhangs and glass, aerial view,
briefing.md is read to the traveller before the visit; audit.md says what was
checked and confirmed, and what is still open.
Isaac app, worn on the back
steps and compass from the motion sensors
tap to call Isaac or to talk
A* for blind and wheelchair profiles
“12 meters, then left”: a distance and a direction,
hazards by height and side, never what things look like
“Take me to the seminar room”, where am I,
one endpoint for the app, the browser and calls:
hands the route to the belt, reads back where
the wearer is; next floor, stop
Raspberry Pi + two servos on a PCA9685 board:
keeps the position, taps each turn
pairing codes, live status, trips, help alerts;
knows whether the phone and the caretaker are online
caretakers and the walker, by text;
polls Photon, so it needs no public URL
status, help alerts and trips by text,
every event and agent call, streamed live
ops dashboard (sign-in), caretaker page, venue routes
only when something goes wrong; routing never waits on a model
plans the way with the traveller
The traveller says yes before any reroute
Routing, tracking and taps are deterministic. The models survey buildings ahead of time, judge every hazard lead with evidence, and handle exceptions; they are never in the loop of a step.
